✅ Build landing page
✅ Add authentication
✅ Integrate payments
⬜ Security (we'll get to it later)
Sound familiar? The issue is that "later" often means "after the first incident." And by then, you've already:
Lost customer trust
Faced potential regulatory fines (GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2)
